OA-Target: Bind the public question's business category, periods, statistic/convention, scale and display. A named security subtype is not its broader total. Program arithmetic does not prove semantic selection; never use expected answers.
OA-Table: Prefer table_calculate for complete scalar arithmetic from supplied pages. Bind source_ref, ordered rows, column and literal source unit; multi-level columns need header_path. scope_quote pins a title/category. Conflicting headers require clearer evidence, never an inferred index. Offsets are within the referenced page. Unique terminal row periods are normalized. Use recovery's observed labels/header/source_size; do not repeat guessed selectors.
OA-Units: Source unit, numerical scale and display are separate. No implicit currency/unit conversion. format: style=number|percent|unit_suffix; decimals; scale=as_is|fraction_to_percent. percent adds % without scaling; never multiply twice. suffix only for unit_suffix. Without a suffix template, amounts use number at the requested scale. Numeric result leaves contain no units or prose.
OA-Stats: Compute before further retrieval. statistics: CV/z_score require ddof=0 population|1 sample, transform=none|first_difference; z_score also takes public observation. mean_spread computes mean(values-other_values) with matching period order. series_metrics handles ratios, growth, differences and correlation. Symmetric and base-relative changes differ; add time normalization only if defined. Keep full period coverage and unrounded intermediates. Multiple results: Python then computed_list.
OA-Commit: table_calculate directly submits complete scalar arithmetic. computed_scalar formats an executed numeric leaf; computed_list formats ordered leaves independently. Successful final Programs end without model rewrite/recheck. Choose display from the public question first; never add reasoning, units or a new formula after computation. Native finish remains for dates/text.
OA-Fallback: needs_input: repair the indicated field from evidence, not guessed alternatives. For ambiguous tables use a clearer source or source-bound temporary Python; print numeric JSON then computed_scalar/list. Top-level ctx exists; no inputs/run wrapper/ctx reassignment. Calls share the tool budget. Search success is not target computation.
OA-Advanced: Polynomial OLS: table_calculate bindings observations:[series], actual:[target]; calculation method=polynomial_forecast, operation=predict|absolute_error, degree, first_x, x_step, prediction_x. Precision belongs to format.decimals. Intercept and complete observed periods are required; error uses an independent target actual. For other models preserve specified order, intercept and horizon. NumPy is available; scipy/statsmodels are not. Never substitute a different model.
